definitions.explanation: A single person as opposed to a group or organization.
Relating to one person rather than to a group.

examples.japanese: これは{個人|こじん}の{意見|いけん}です。
{個人|こじん}{情報|じょうほう}を{守|まも}る。
{法人|ほうじん}ではなく{個人|こじん}として{契約|けいやく}した。
examples.english: I signed the contract as an individual, not as a corporation.

examples.japanese: {個人|こじん}の{自由|じゆう}は{尊重|そんちょう}されるべきだが、{同時|どうじ}に{社会|しゃかい}{的|てき}{責任|せきにん}も{忘|わす}れてはならない。
examples.english: Individual freedom should be respected, but at the same time, we must not forget social responsibility.

notes:
{個人|こじん} means individual or personal.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {個人|こじん}として (as an individual)
- {個人|こじん}{的|てき}に (personally)
- {個人|こじん}{差|さ} (individual differences)

COMPOUND WORDS:
- {個人|こじん}{情報|じょうほう} (personal information)
- {個人|こじん}{経営|けいえい} (sole proprietorship)
- {個人|こじん}{主義|しゅぎ} (individualism)
- {個人|こじん}{事業|じぎょう}{主|ぬし} (sole proprietor)

CONTRAST:
- {個人|こじん} (individual) ↔ {法人|ほうじん} (corporation)
- {個人|こじん} (individual) ↔ {団体|だんたい} (group, organization)
- {個人|こじん}{的|てき} (personal) ↔ {公的|こうてき} (public, official)
